info.title: Recourse API
info.summary: Read claims and build the unsigned transactions for every user action. Testnet only.
info.description: One HTTP API for the web app and for agents. Reads under /v1 return JSON with stable field names and a `meta` block. Actions under /v1/actions take JSON and return the unsigned transactions to sign, in order, with a preview of what they do; the API never signs, never holds a key and never broadcasts. Orders are paid by x402 at the shop, which answers with the payment request (the shop paths below carry their own server). Every non-2xx answer under /v1 is `{error: {code, message, details?}}` with a code from a fixed list. Integers that come from a chain (amounts, ids, times, gas) are decimal strings. Chains: Hedera testnet (296) and Arbitrum Sepolia (421614); the vault token is mUSDC, a testnet mock with 6 decimals. Clients ignore fields they do not know; fields are only ever added within v1.

servers.description: Through the web app's origin (public). The web server forwards /api/<path> to the status API as /<path>.
The status API on its own host (loopback only).

get.summary: The registered shops and agent companies
get.description: Every party in the party map with an ERC-8004 agent id: its owner and agentURI read from the identity registry on Hedera, the name, description and `recourse` type of its registration document, the orders its records name on the records topic and its claims with their outcomes. Not paged, like /v1/claims. The registry is read at most every 30 s an agent and waited on for at most 3 s: a slower or failing relay answers with the last values read, `current: false` on those members, and `identity` in meta.degraded.

post.description:
Builds `approve` (only when the shop's allowance to the vault is below the court fee; exact amount, never unlimited) and `RecourseClaims.fileClaim(orderNonce, platform, refs, basketUsdc, netLossUsdc)` on Hedera. `from` is the shop.

**The caller sends** `from`, and `platform` + `orderNonce` (or `orderId` alone for an order this deployment's shop took), and optionally `netLossUsdc`, `basketUsdc`, `allowUnpacked`.

**The API derives** `orderId = orderIdOf(platform, from, orderNonce)`; `claimId = claimIdOf(296, RecourseClaims, orderId)` (checked against `claimIdFor`); `refs` from its records-topic index (per kind, the earliest message for the order paid by the order's own writers: the platform's for asked, shown, approval, ordered and arrived, the shop's for packed); `basketUsdc` from the ordered record document (its `amount` and `asset`, as micro-USDC: tinybar / 100 rounded up for HBAR); the court fee from `params()`, `handlingOf(basketUsdc)`, the allowance and balance on `vault.usdc()`.

**Checks, in order:** fields; `same_party`; the ordered record (`no_ordered_record`, `ordered_unreadable`, and with `orderId` alone `order_nonce_unknown`, `not_paid`, `ordered_tx_mismatch`); `no_packed_record` unless `allowUnpacked`; `zero_basket`, `basket_mismatch`, `net_loss_above_basket`; `claim_exists`; `exit_due`; `insufficient_balance`; then an eth_call of fileClaim when no approve is needed. A records topic that is behind or failing answers `upstream_unavailable` (upstream `index`), not `no_ordered_record`.

**Preview amounts:** basket, netLoss, handling (info); courtFee (escrow, the shop); maxPayout (reserve, the platform; info with no account on a vault from before reservations, which holds nothing back at filing). With an approve first, fileClaim is not simulated and gets an 800000 gas budget; building again once the approve has mined simulates it. `input.expectedFinding` is the shared fault rule on the referenced records.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

transactions.description: Allow the deposit vault to take the 1.00 mUSDC court fee (exact amount).
File the claim for order 0xf60aebf5...: escrows the court fee and reserves the platform's deposit.

preview.summary: File a claim for 25.00 mUSDC against the platform; 1.00 mUSDC court fee is escrowed from your account.
changes: Your allowance to the deposit vault is set to 1.00 mUSDC.
The claim is filed (status filed) and the court fee moves into its escrow.
Up to 28.25 mUSDC of the platform's deposit is reserved for this claim.
The pre-check service then records a finding on its own.
notes: Send fileClaim only after approve has mined: it cannot be simulated before then, so its gas limit is a fixed 800000 budget. Building again once approve has mined simulates it and gives an estimate instead.

post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.contest(claimId)` on Hedera. Only the side the pre-check went against may sign: the platform when the answer is 1, otherwise the shop (`not_contester`, 403). The claim must be PreChecked (`wrong_status`) and inside its window, `preCheckedAt + claimTermsOf(claimId).contestWindow` inclusive (`window_closed`); `notAfter` is that second. A claims contract from before per-claim terms has no `claimTermsOf` and checks against its current `params()`, so the API does too and adds a note saying so. Moves no money: the court fee was escrowed at filing. Preview amounts: courtFee (info).

x-recourse-call.signer: the losing side (platform if answer is 1, else the shop)

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

preview.summary: Contest the pre-check finding; the claim then goes to court.
changes: Anyone can then send it to court (sendToCourt); the keeper does so on its own.
notes: Contesting moves no mUSDC: the court fee was escrowed when the claim was filed.

post.description: Builds `EvidenceModule.submitEvidence(externalId, evidence)` on Arbitrum Sepolia, the Kleros evidence module the case's disputes use (`params.addresses.evidenceModule`). `externalId = externalIdUint(421614, RecourseCase, claimId, attempt)`; `evidence` is `JSON.stringify({name, description, fileURI?})` built from the request, at most 49152 UTF-8 bytes (`evidence_too_large`). A dispute must exist for the attempt (`caseOf(claimId).disputeIds[attempt-1] != 0`, else `no_dispute`). The module takes evidence from any account and at any period; the preview notes the current period. Moves no money.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

transactions.description: File evidence in the claim's Kleros dispute (attempt 1).

preview.summary: Add evidence to the claim's court case on Kleros.
changes: An Evidence event is recorded for the dispute; the court shows it under your address.

post.description: Builds `DepositVault.withdrawCredit()` on Hedera: pays the signer's whole credit (`creditOf(from)`) to the signer. `no_credit` when it is 0; `not_associated` when the token refuses the transfer (Circle USDC needs the account associated first; the testnet mock does not). Preview amounts: credit (receive, the signer). `readBack` is the signer's party path.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

transactions.description: Withdraw your whole vault credit to your account.

preview.summary: Withdraw 28.25 mUSDC of credit from the deposit vault to your account.
changes: Your vault credit goes to 0 and the amount arrives in your account.

post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.closeUncontested(claimId)` on Hedera; anyone may sign. The claim must be PreChecked (`wrong_status`) with its contest window over (`window_open`). Preview amounts from `previewSettle(claimId)`: toShop (credit, the shop: net loss + handling when the finding was against the platform, else 0) and feeRefund (credit, the shop).

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

preview.summary: Close the claim uncontested: the shop is credited 27.25 mUSDC plus the 1.00 mUSDC fee refund.
changes: The shop's vault credit grows; it withdraws with withdrawCredit.
notes: The payout is capped at what the platform's deposit has reserved for the claim.

post.summary: Send a contested claim to court
post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.sendToCourt(claimId)` on Hedera; anyone may sign. The claim must be Contested (`wrong_status`). The CCIP fee (`quoteSend(claimId)`, in the contract's fee token, LINK or HBAR) is paid from the claims contract's own balance (`contract_underfunded` when short). Preview amounts: ccipFee (contract_pays). The keeper sends on its own; this is for when it has not.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.resend(claimId)` on Hedera; anyone may sign. The claim must be AtCourt (`wrong_status`), the bridge must send (`bridge_unavailable`), the last send at least `resendGap` ago (`resend_too_soon`) and fewer than `maxSends` sends made (`max_sends_reached`). The CCIP fee comes from the contract's balance. Preview amounts: ccipFee (contract_pays).

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.expireClaim(claimId)` on Hedera; anyone may sign. Filed claims expire once `filedAt + claimTimeout` has passed, Contested and AtCourt ones once `preCheckedAt + claimTimeout` has (the claim's own terms, or `params()` on a claims contract from before per-claim terms); else `not_expired` or `wrong_status`. Preview amounts: feeRefund (credit, the shop). A note warns when a ruling is on its way back, which expiring would discard.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

post.description: Builds `RecourseClaims.settle(claimId)` on Hedera; anyone may sign. The claim must be Ruled (`wrong_status`). Preview amounts from `previewSettle(claimId)`: toShop (credit, the shop, before the cap of the platform's reserved deposit) and toPool (info: the escrowed fee goes to the pool).

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

preview.summary: Apply the ruling: the shop is credited 28.25 mUSDC from the platform's deposit.
changes: The escrowed court fee goes to the fee pool.
notes: The payout is capped at what the platform's deposit has reserved for the claim.

post.description: Builds `RecourseCase.openCase(payload)` on Arbitrum Sepolia; anyone may sign. `payload` is the ClaimToCourt payload of the claim's ClaimReceived event, from the index. The case must be Received (`case_wrong_state`); a full open-case limit answers `cap_reached`, a short fee pool `contract_underfunded`. The dispute cost (`costNow()`) is paid from the contract's fee pool. Preview amounts: disputeCost (contract_pays, ETH). A note says when no court round is left, in which case the call marks the case stale instead of opening it. The keeper opens cases on its own.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

post.description: Builds `RecourseCase.refile(payload)` on Arbitrum Sepolia after the court refused to rule on the first attempt; anyone may sign. The case must be RefilePending on attempt 1 (`case_wrong_state`). Payload, cost and notes as for openCase.

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

post.description: Builds `RecourseCase.relayRuling(claimId)` on Arbitrum Sepolia; anyone may sign. The case must be Ruled or Relayed (`case_wrong_state`), the peer set (`bridge_unavailable`), fewer than maxSends sends (`max_sends_reached`) and the last send at least resendGap ago (`resend_too_soon`). With payIn native the value is exactly `quoteRelayNative(claimId)` (the contract forwards exactly the fee and returns no change); with payIn link the value is 0 and the contract's LINK pays (`contract_underfunded`). Preview amounts: ccipFee (send, the signer; or contract_pays in LINK).

200.description: Unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing is signed or sent.

transactions.description: Relay the ruling to Hedera over CCIP, paying the fee in ETH.

preview.summary: Send the court's ruling back to Hedera; you pay the CCIP fee in ETH.
changes: A CCIP message carries the ruling to Hedera; the claim becomes ruled when it lands.
notes: The value is the exact quote. If the fee rises before this mines, the call reverts (insufficient_value) and only gas is spent.

post.description: The order action. It changes chain state by payment, so it answers with the x402 payment request, not a transaction: the first request (no payment header) gets 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; the payer signs a Hedera transfer for it with its own key and sends the same request again with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and the order body. The shop settles before taking the order and journals it, then answers 200 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE. The paying account must be one of the platform's record writers. The asked, shown and approval records must already be on the records topic.

Address.description: EVM address. Requests take any case; responses are EIP-55 checksummed.

Bytes32.description: 32 bytes as 0x + 64 hex. Responses are lower case.

Uint.description: An unsigned integer as a decimal string. Every amount, id, gas figure and chain time is sent this way, because many do not fit a JSON number.

UnixSeconds.description: Unix seconds as a decimal string (chain time).

Chain.description: hedera: Hedera testnet (chain id 296). arbitrum: Arbitrum Sepolia (chain id 421614).

StatusKey.description: The claim's status as shown to people (packages/shared status.ts).

NextCall.description: The contract call that moves the claim on. Every value except recordPreCheck and manualExecute is also an action name under /v1/actions.

ActionName.description: An action: the name of the contract function it builds, and the last segment of its path under /v1/actions.

VaultToken.description: The token every vault amount is in. On this testnet deployment: mUSDC, a mock with 6 decimals.

ConfigLock.description: Whether each contract's owner can still change the rules; null while not read.

asOf.description: Unix seconds (JSON numbers) each source is indexed through; null before the first full read.

degraded.description: Sources whose data is late or whose last read failed. `params`, `facts` (the contract facts of /v1/params), `vault` (a party's deposit, credit and standing) and `live` (court case, CCIP delivery and Kleros reads): the last live read failed or did not answer within the read wait (about 3 s), and the answer carries the value read before; `stale` says how old it is. `identity` (on /v1/cast only): a read of the ERC-8004 identity registry, or of a registration document, is not current.

readAt.description: Unix seconds of the value served; null when none was ever read (the field is null, or the parameters are the defaults).

stale.description: Each live read in `degraded` answered from its last good value: which read, the RPCs it reads, and how old the value is. Empty while every live read is current.

Meta.description: Freshness of the answer. On every /v1 read.

Escrow.description: The court fee escrowed from the shop at filing, in vault-token base units, as the vault's FeeEscrowed event gave it: 0 with fate none until that event is indexed.

NextAction.description: The action that builds nextCall, when this API builds it; null when nothing is due or the call is not one of the actions (recordPreCheck, manualExecute).

gap.description: Pre-check gap code; null before the pre-check.

answer.description: Pre-check answer: 0 unknown, 1 platform, 2 shop (merchant), 3 neither; null before the pre-check.

ClaimSummary.description: One claim in a list. Amounts are vault-token base units (6 decimals).

seq.description: HCS sequence number of the record message; 0 when none.

payerOk.description: The payer is one of the writers this record counts from (the order's own platform or shop once a claim names them).

held.description: true verified, false absent or failed a check, null not checked yet.

refsMatch.description: The message's hash equals the claim's on-chain reference for this kind.

doc.description: The record document when held and verified, else null.

unread.description: The topic has not been read far enough to say whether the record exists.

Refs.description: The RecordRefs tuple fileClaim takes: the records topic number (N of 0.0.N), and per kind (asked, shown, approval, ordered, packed, arrived) the message's sequence number and the document's SHA-256. A missing record has seq 0 and a zero hash.

final.description: Arbitrum only: at or under the finalized block.

args.description: Decoded event arguments by name; integers as decimal strings; strings over 70 characters left out.

result.description: The pre-check service's result for the claim, as it serves it; null when unreachable.

anyOf.description: Last second of the contest window: preCheckedAt + the claim's own contestWindow (claimTermsOf, fixed at filing).

executionState.description: CCIP OffRamp state: 0 untouched, 1 in progress, 2 success, 3 failure.

reviews.description: As the docket serves it; null when unreachable.

ClaimDetail.description: One claim in full: the summary fields plus records, pre-check, contest, court, bridge, money, docket and events.

escrowOpen.description: Court fees the vault holds in escrow with this address as the shop: the vault's shopEscrowOf when read, else the sum over its indexed claims that still hold their fee. A platform's own figure never includes its shops' fees.

Party.description: A party's standing. The vault fields are null for an address that is neither a known party nor in an indexed claim (not read).

PartyGroups.description: Claim ids of the party's claims, grouped by who acts next.

reader.description: Live chain reads are configured (actions need them).

Health.description: Index and source health. More fields may be present.

claims.description: RecourseClaims params() now. A filed claim keeps the contestWindow, claimTimeout and handling it was filed under (claimTermsOf).

defaulted.description: true: the chain could not be read and the values are the deployment defaults.

Params.description: Contract addresses, live parameters and what the owner can still change.

ErrorCode.description: Fixed list; see x-recourse-error-codes for each code's HTTP status and meaning. New codes may be added; a client treats an unknown code by its HTTP status.

name.description: The custom error's name, or 'reverted' when the node gave no reason.

args.description: The error's arguments as strings (integers in decimal).

Revert.description: The revert a simulated eth_call returned.

ErrorDetails.description: Facts about the error. Which fields appear depends on the code (see x-recourse-error-codes and x-recourse-revert-map); unknown fields may appear and are to be ignored.

message.description: One plain sentence for people. Never holds a URL, key or stack trace.

Error.description: Every non-2xx answer under /v1 has this shape.

from.description: The account that will sign. Every check and the gas estimate are made as this account. On Hedera this is the EVM address of an ECDSA (secp256k1) account.

ActionRequest.description: Every action takes `from`. Bodies are closed: a field not listed is refused with unknown_field, so no key, seed or password can be sent.

ClaimActionRequest.description: An action on one claim: `from` signs, `claimId` names the claim.

from.description: The shop: fileClaim's msg.sender, and the claim's shop.

platform.description: The platform the order was placed through (the x-recourse-platform header the order was paid with).

orderNonce.description: The order nonce (the x-recourse-order-nonce header the order was paid with).

orderId.description: The order id. Alone, it asks the shop service for orderNonce and platform; that works only for orders this deployment's shop took. With orderNonce and platform it must match them.

netLossUsdc.description: Claimed loss in vault-token base units (6 decimals). Default: the whole basket. At most the basket.

basketUsdc.description: Optional. The API reads the basket from the ordered record; when sent it must equal that amount.

allowUnpacked.description: File even though the topic holds no packed record from the shop.

FileClaimRequest.description: File a claim. Send platform and orderNonce (or orderId alone for an order this deployment's shop took). The API derives orderId, claimId, the record refs and the basket itself.

from.description: The account the court will show as the evidence's party. The evidence module accepts any account.

attempt.description: Court attempt. Default: the case's current one (2 after a refile).

name.description: Evidence title, shown by the court.

description.description: Evidence text; the court renders it as Markdown.

fileURI.description: Optional link to a file the caller pinned itself, as /ipfs/<cid> or https://. The API pins nothing.

SubmitEvidenceRequest.description: Add evidence to the claim's Kleros dispute. The API builds the evidence string as JSON {name, description, fileURI?} in that order; its UTF-8 size must be at most 49152 bytes.

from.description: The account whose whole vault credit is paid out to itself.

WithdrawCreditRequest.description: Withdraw the signer's whole credit from the deposit vault.

payIn.description: native: the signer pays the CCIP fee in ETH as the transaction's value (quoteRelayNative). link: the contract pays from its own LINK.

RelayRulingRequest.description: Relay the ruling from Arbitrum to Hedera over CCIP.

name.description: Fixed per action; see each action's description.

display.description: The amount in whole units with its symbol, for showing.

movement.description: escrow: leaves `account`'s wallet into the claim's escrow. reserve: held from `account`'s vault deposit. credit: added to `account`'s vault credit. receive: arrives in `account`'s wallet. send: the transaction's value, paid by `account`. contract_pays: a contract pays from its own balance. info: nothing moves.

Amount.description: One amount the action moves or shows.

amount.description: gas x gasPrice summed over the transactions, in the chain's smallest EVM unit (weibar on Hedera, wei on Arbitrum; both 18 decimals).

basis.description: estimate: every transaction's gas came from eth_estimateGas. budget: at least one used a fixed budget because it could not be simulated before an earlier transaction in the list mines.

NativeFee.description: The network fee the signer pays, an upper bound from the gas limit at the build's gas price. Hedera charges for the gas the call uses, so the fee is at most this.

changes.description: What changes on chain, in plain sentences, in order.

anyOf.description: The claim's statusKey once the last transaction mines; null when it does not change directly (withdrawCredit, submitEvidence, relayRuling).

notes.description: Warnings and facts to show before signing.

Preview.description: What the action will do, to show before anything is signed.

value.description: Value in the chain's smallest EVM unit (wei; weibar on Hedera). 0 for every action but relayRuling with payIn native.

gas.description: Gas limit: eth_estimateGas with a margin (x1.3 on Hedera, x1.2 on Arbitrum), or a fixed budget when simulated is false.

gasPrice.description: The gas price the fee estimate used (legacy pricing). A wallet may set its own.

args.description: The decoded arguments by name, integers as decimal strings, so the caller can check `data` before signing.

simulated.description: This transaction was run as an eth_call from `from` against the latest block and did not revert.

UnsignedTransaction.description: One transaction to sign and send, unchanged except for nonce and fee fields the wallet sets. The API never signs, never holds a key and never broadcasts.

handlingUsdc.description: handlingOf(basketUsdc): fixed into the claim's terms at filing.

maxPayoutUsdc.description: netLoss + handling + court fee: what the vault reserves from the platform's deposit.

orderSource.description: Where orderNonce and platform came from.

expectedFinding.description: The shared fault rule run on the records the refs name, as the pre-check will run it. Indicative: the pre-check service records the finding.

FileClaimInput.description: What fileClaim derived and will send.

ClaimCallInput.description: The claim as read from the chain at build time.

externalId.description: externalIdUint(421614, RecourseCase, claimId, attempt): the evidence group the court files it under.

evidence.description: The exact string passed to submitEvidence.

from.description: The account that must sign every transaction, as sent.

transactions.description: In signing order. Send each only after the one before it has mined.

simulated.description: true when every transaction was simulated without a revert. false when a later one depends on an earlier one mining first (fileClaim after approve); the API has then checked balance, allowance, exit and claim state itself.

builtAt.description: Timestamp of the latest block the checks ran against.

anyOf.description: Last second the call is expected to succeed (for example the contest window's end); null when there is no such deadline.

readBack.description: The /v1 path that shows the new state once the index has the transaction.

input.description: What the action read and derived.

ActionResponse.description: An action's answer: unsigned transactions and a preview. Nothing has changed on any chain yet.

error.description: A code only; the shop's errors have no message.

ShopError.description: The shop's error shape: {error: code}, sometimes with extra fields (orderId, expected, issues, order, max).

orderId.description: orderIdOf(platform, shop, orderNonce): keccak256(abi.encode("recourse.order.v1", platform, shop, orderNonce)).

refs.description: The three records the platform wrote to the records topic before paying.

OrderBody.description: Body of a paid order request. Required with a payment header; ignored without one.

amount.description: Atomic units: tinybar for HBAR (asset 0.0.0), micro-USDC for USDC.

extra.description: paymentFlow 'upfront' (settled before the order is taken) and the facilitator's feePayer account.

X402PaymentRequired.description: The x402 v2 PaymentRequired object, sent base64-encoded in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of a 402. The payer signs a Hedera transfer for it and retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

txId.description: Hedera transaction id of the payment.

Conflict.description: Error (claim_exists, wrong_status, window_closed, window_open, not_expired, exit_due, insufficient_balance, no_credit, not_associated, vault_not_ready, resend_too_soon, max_sends_reached, bridge_unavailable, contract_underfunded, insufficient_value, case_wrong_state, cap_reached, no_dispute, call_reverted).

Unprocessable.description: Error (same_party, order_id_mismatch, order_nonce_unknown, not_paid, no_ordered_record, ordered_unreadable, ordered_tx_mismatch, no_packed_record, zero_basket, basket_too_large, basket_mismatch, net_loss_above_basket, evidence_too_large).

ProxyUnavailable.description: Error (upstream_unavailable) from the web server in front of the API, on /api/v1/...: the status API did not answer within 15 s, or could not be reached. It has no details. The status API itself answers every read within about 3 s and every action within 12 s, so this means it is down or restarting; try again shortly.

x-recourse-error-codes.meaning: The body is not JSON, or not a JSON object.
A required field is missing. details.field names it.
A field has the wrong type, shape or range. details.field and details.reason say which and why.
The body has a field this action does not take. details.field names it. No action takes a key, seed or password.
Only the side the pre-check went against may contest: the platform when the answer is 1, otherwise the shop. details.contester is that address.
No such route, claim, order, party or case. details.resource says which; details.id echoes the id. A claim filed moments ago is found once the index reaches it.
The path exists but not for this HTTP method.
The body is over 64 KB.
The platform is the signer itself (contract error SameParty).
orderNonce, platform and from do not hash to the orderId sent; details.derivedOrderId is the one they hash to.
Only orderId was sent and the shop service does not know the order: send orderNonce and platform.
The shop service has no accepted payment for the order (orderId-only requests).
The records topic holds no ordered record for the order from the order's own platform (contract error MissingOrdered).
The ordered record's document does not match its hash or is not a record document, so the basket cannot be read from it.
The ordered record names a payment other than the one the shop service settled (orderId-only requests).
The topic holds no packed record from the shop. Without one the fault rule answers against the shop from its packed step on; send allowUnpacked: true to file anyway.
The basket is zero (contract error ZeroBasket).
The basket is above the contract limit (contract error BasketTooLarge).
basketUsdc was sent and differs from the amount the ordered record says was paid. details.derived holds that amount.
netLossUsdc is above the basket (contract error NetLossAboveBasket).
The evidence string is over 49152 UTF-8 bytes. details.bytes and details.max say by how much.
A claim for this order is already filed (ClaimExists, or the vault's EscrowExists). details.claimId names it.
The claim's status does not allow this call (WrongStatus). details.status and details.statusName give the current one.
The contest window has closed (WindowClosed). details.closesAt is its last second.
The contest window is still open (WindowOpen); the claim cannot close uncontested yet. details.closesAt.
The claim's timeout has not passed (NotExpired). details.expiresAfter: the call works from the second after it.
The platform's exit from the deposit vault is due, so the vault takes no new claim against it (ExitDue).
The signer holds less of the vault token than the court fee (the vault's TransferFailed). details.balance, details.required.
The signer has no credit in the deposit vault (NoCredit).
The token refused the transfer to the signer: on Circle USDC the account must be associated with the token first (NotAssociated). details.account.
The vault is not associated with its token yet (NotAssociatedYet).
The last send was too recent (ResendTooSoon on Hedera, SendTooSoon on Arbitrum). details.availableAt.
The message was already sent the most times allowed (MaxSendsReached).
The bridge is off for this call: no peer set, or the mode does not send (PeerNotSet, WrongMode, RelayDisabled).
The contract that pays this fee holds too little (LinkShort, NativeShort, FeePoolLow, InsufficientLink). details.have, details.need, details.asset.
The value sent is below the CCIP fee (InsufficientValue): the fee rose since the build. Build again. details.sent, details.need.
The court case on Arbitrum is not in a state this call takes (WrongState). details.state and details.stateName.
The open-case limit on Arbitrum is reached (CapReached); the case opens once a slot frees.
No dispute is open for this claim and attempt yet, so there is nowhere to file evidence.
The simulated call reverted with an error not listed above. details.revert names it.
Too many requests from this client. details.retryAfterS; the Retry-After header says the same.
An unexpected failure in the API. The message carries no detail from inside the server.

A source the answer needs did not answer or is behind: details.upstream is one of index, hedera_rpc, arbitrum_rpc, mirror, ipfs, shop, precheck, docket, status_api. Retry later. The web server in front answers it with HTTP 502 and no details when the status API itself does not answer (ProxyUnavailable).

x-recourse-revert-map.error: any other custom error, or a revert with no reason
